---
title: "link-external: icon true + newwindow"
# bd-t3n1nghb: external body links get class `external` (drawn by the
# link-external.scss layer) and target/rel; relative, filter-matched,
# mailto and `.no-external` links are untouched, and an author's own
# `target` survives.
format:
  html:
    link-external-icon: true
    link-external-newwindow: true
    link-external-filter: '^(?:http:|https:)\/\/www\.quarto\.org\/'
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            'a.external[href="https://example.com/"][target="_blank"][rel="noopener"]',
            'a.external[href="https://example.org/own"][target="frame"][rel="noopener"]',
            'a[href="mailto:someone@example.com"]',
          ]
        - [
            'a[href="about.html"][target]',
            'a.external[href="about.html"]',
            'a[href^="https://www.quarto.org/"][target]',
            'a.external[href^="https://www.quarto.org/"]',
            'a.external[href^="mailto:"]',
            'a.no-external[target]',
            'a.no-external.external',
          ]
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        - ['a\.external:after\{', '\.quarto-ext-icon\{']
        - []
---

- internal: [about](about.html)
- external: [example](https://example.com/)
- author target: [own](https://example.org/own){target="frame"}
- filter-matched: [quarto](https://www.quarto.org/docs/)
- mailto: [mail](mailto:someone@example.com)
- opted out: [skip](https://example.net/){.no-external}
